_comment: Target registry for the Morserino-32 web installer (m32_installer.html).
and 'versions' path below is relative to that file's own location.
The installer detects the connected chip and keeps the targets whose
chipFamily matches. One survivor is used silently; several become the
'Edition' choice, in the order listed here. Adding a hardware variant is
an entry here, not a code change.
Offsets are decimal. See devdocs/installer/PLAN.md for the layout and for
why boot_app0 must be written on every install (it resets the OTA
selector, which matters when switching between editions whose partition
'manual' is the slug of the user manual that belongs to this target; the
installer builds the release-asset URL from it, so the base can move
without editing these entries. 'manualName' is the device name spoken in
the link text — write it to be read aloud, not to be scanned. 'accessible'
marks the edition built for blind and partially sighted operators: its
manual is offered as EPUB first, PDF second. A target without 'manual'

targets.label: Accessibility Edition
targets.note: Speaks the menus and settings aloud, for blind and partially sighted operators. The games are not included.
